name: ROBE
canonical: the finest festal robe of the house, a long flowing outer garment of rich dyed cloth with woven border-bands, laid out to drape over a returning son's shoulders. A best ceremonial mantle of honour — NOT a plain peasant tunic, NOT a modern coat or bathrobe; the costliest robe
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
